# Supabase browser dependency

`supabase.js` is the browser bundle downloaded from the same jsDelivr `@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.js` endpoint used by the app on 2026-09-28. It is now committed and served with the app so its exact bytes can load offline. Its MIT license is included alongside it. Updates require replacing the bundle, updating the service-worker cache version, and running browser regressions.

Vendored bundle version: **2.117.2**. SHA-256: `59d39487c3589843b410322d8a3d562ce022aba1e5ccb16898ef3fb2a0da2ecd`.
